title: Aura Engine Product Manifest
description: Single source of truth shared across all Aura Engine skills. Every skill reads and updates this manifest. DO NOT edit manually.

product_slug.description: URL-safe slug of the product. Used as the directory name under /workspace/.

product_url.description: Primary product URL provided by the member (optional).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the manifest was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last manifest update.

budget_tier.description: Internal budget tier captured from the setup input (daily ad budget). Derived from budget_daily; budget_daily is the canonical numeric source.

budget_daily.description: CANONICAL daily ad budget in USD (numeric). Written by 00-setup from the member's BUDGET answer (budget_tier is derived from it); updated if the member declares a new budget in later skills. Read by member-stage-awareness.md (stage inference signal budget_daily < 50), skill 07c (analytics stack decision tree) and skill 10 (test budget context). Legacy manifests without it: fall back to budget_tier + the 'Budget diário' line in profile.md.

skills_completed.description: Ordered list of canonical skill IDs already completed. These are the ONLY valid IDs — never invent variants (e.g. '07c-page-deploy' does not exist; the deploy skill is '07b-page-build' and 07c is tracking-setup). Downstream pre-flights match against these exact strings.

voc_count.description: Number of unique, verbatim voice-of-customer phrases captured in skill 02.

voc_adequacy.description: Qualitative adequacy of the VOC corpus, written by skill 02 alongside voc_count. Read by skill 06 as a copy gate: 'insufficient' means copy should not anchor on VOC-driven claims until skill 02 is re-run with more sources.

page_type.description: Page format chosen by dominant awareness level. Written by skill 07a (page-design); read by 07b and by skill 09 (consistency audit, coherence check against 02 awareness).

signals_source.description: Where the brand signals came from (07a ETAPA 2 cascade: Refero MCP -> screenshot->vision -> manual). Written by skill 07a.

psm_real.description: PSM real = LTV / (CPA + COGS). CANONICAL formula and CANONICAL source. Written ONLY by skill 11 (ad-analysis) from live performance; read by skill 12 (scale). Skill 12 must NOT recompute psm_real with a different formula.

breakeven_roas.description: Break-even ROAS given the current offer economics.

product_vertical.description: Product vertical used by compliance pre-flight (checker.md) to pick the right red-flag rule set. Set during skill 00-setup or 01-product-research. Default 'other' if ambiguous.

copy_language.description: Language of CONSUMER-facing copy (ads, pages, PDPs, emails) — always 'en' for the US market regardless of report_language (CLAUDE.md rule 0). Member-facing report language lives in report_language, not here. Written by 00-setup.

market.description: Primary market / geography (e.g. 'US', 'BR', 'EU'). Set during 00-setup. Required by skill 02 ([GEOGRAPHY] in the awareness/sophistication prompt).

report_language.description: Language for INTERNAL reports and member-facing conversation. Mirrored from profile.md by 00-setup so every skill can read it structurally (CLAUDE.md rule 0). Public copy (ads/pages) is always English regardless.

stage.description: CANONICAL behavioral stage (member-stage-awareness.md). Written by 00-setup (situation A/B->starter, C->validating, D->scaling) and updated by 11/12. This is the single source of truth for stage; budget_tier is a separate economic field, NOT a stage vocabulary. Do not introduce other stage enums (traction/initial_scale/etc are deprecated).

esp.description: Email service provider. Captured in 00-setup ETAPA 3. Hard pre-flight input for skill 13 (retention). 'none' = member has no ESP yet.

store_url.description: Canonical .myshopify.com (or custom domain) store handle. Captured in 00-setup when a Shopify link is provided; otherwise written by skill 07b (page-build) at deploy. Consumed by 07b/07c/07d + skill 13.

tracking.description: Tracking status block. Written by skill 07c (tracking-setup); read by skills 08 and 10 pre-flights via manifest.tracking.tracking_ready and manifest.tracking.analytics_stack (canonical paths — never flat top-level variants like manifest.tracking_stack).

pixel_installed.description: Meta Pixel base code live on the storefront.

emq_score.description: Event Match Quality from Meta Events Manager (0-10 scale). Quality gate: EMQ >= 6.0. null when not yet measured (needs traffic).

analytics_stack.description: Attribution stack chosen in 07c ETAPA 4. Read by skills 10 and 11 to orient data reading.

tracking_ready.description: True only when Pixel + CAPI are validated with EMQ >= 6.0 (or the member explicitly accepted degraded signal via escape path ES1). Hard pre-flight for skills 08 and 10.

storefront.description: Published page block. Written by skill 07b (page-build) at deploy/publish; read by 07d (operates on the theme where the page lives) and by skill 10 (campaign destination URL — canonical source, NEVER taken from the 06 copy report).

theme_id.description: Shopify theme ID where the page lives.

page_url.description: Final public URL of the published page. Skill 10 reads this as the campaign destination URL.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the page went live.

agentic.description: Agentic readiness block. Written by skill 07e (agentic-readiness) after the AEO checklist runs against the live store; read by skill 09 as informative context (NOT a launch gate) and by skill 12 to treat AI-referral traffic as an incremental scale source.

ready.description: True when ai_visibility_score >= 80 and no blocked_pending structured-data items remain.

channel_enabled.description: Agentic Storefronts sales channel enabled in the Shopify admin with the required policies complete.

score.description: AI visibility score (passed items / applicable items, in %). Full checklist detail lives in 07e-agentic-readiness/dados.json.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last 07e run.

10_campaign_name.description: Campaign name (naming convention) generated by skill 10. Read by skill 11 and by the Meta sync recipe (sync-campaign-from-meta.md) to match Meta data.

10_campaign_id.description: Meta campaign ID, written by skill 10 when the campaign is created via MCP. Skill 11 pulls insights by ID (more robust than by name).

10_ad_set_id.description: Meta ad set ID (canonical structure: 1 Advantage+ campaign -> 1 ad set -> N ads). Written by skill 10 when created via MCP; read by skill 11 and automation recipes.

aov_baseline.description: Average order value baseline in USD. Captured in 00-setup for situation C/D (already selling); otherwise computed in skill 04. Feeds breakeven_roas / PSM so 10/11/12 do not re-ask.

cogs_estimate.description: Approximate per-order COGS+shipping in USD. Captured in 00-setup for C/D; refined in skill 04 (cogs_breakdown). Used for PSM = LTV / (CPA + COGS).

batch_count.description: Number of creative batches launched. Written by skill 08. Read by member-stage-awareness.md for stage inference.

analysis_count.description: Number of skill 11 (ad-analysis) runs on this product. Incremented by skill 11 at wrap-up (skills_completed only records '11-ad-analysis' once); tracks analysis cadence.

champions.description: Active winning Post IDs. Written by skill 11/08. Read by member-stage-awareness.md and skill 12.

winners.description: Winning creatives with metrics (creative_id, cpa, spend_total, days_active, outcome). Written by skill 11; consumed by skill 14 (content-recycler).

margin_warning.description: True if skill 04 flagged weighted margin < $20. Read by 10/12 as a scaling caution.

compliance_override.description: Set only when the member explicitly overrides a compliance BLOCK (emergency-escape-paths ES3). Records {reason, risk, gate, timestamp}.

skipped_preflight.description: Artifacts a skill proceeded without (emergency-escape-paths ES1). Lets downstream skills and the consistency audit know the chain ran on partial inputs.
